svg.title: The wire is the scanners'; the harness adds the images, the decoys and the postures
svg.text: Same wire. The delta is in the images and the structure.
the same findings, its own file reader, and rules
no false positive; 2 keyed out of reach
the same 38: nothing added on the wire
a rule over both layers, per listener
its own file reader: an ML-DSA certificate and key,
a keystore, DSA and Ed25519 host keys; and the rules
cost per image: the harness's reader 1.0 to 7.6 s; cbomkit-theia 75 to 136 s, nearly all of it in its secrets plugin
a TLS listener 27 to 46 s, an SSH listener 2 to 3 s (four-service slice, 2026-10-03)
